desc: The TriStar Raptor Series is our most affordable line of Semi-Automatic Shotguns. Offered in 12ga and 20ga along with a 20ga Youth model. The Raptor is a 3" gas-operated shotgun. It features a highly durable molded stock and forearm, with a zero-plane stock for better feel. The Raptor comes standard with a fiber optic front sight, 3 Beretta®/Benelli® chokes (IC, M, F), and a ventilated butt pad.
